To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the surface of coatings deposited in CVD process has the character of fractal, which is confirmed by a fractal dimension D2, calculated from a power spectrum of the surface.
the surface topography of the CVD coatings is fractal, the fractal dimension of their surfaces is between 2.0 and 2.4 and the fractal dimension increases with the increasing of the coating thickness.
the surface roughness of the coatings obtained in CVD processes on tools is a function of the type of process and process conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a correlation between fractal quantities of surface topography and properties of coatings obtained by CVD.
the possibility of prediction of coatings' properties based on the fractal quantities describing its surface.
the analysis of the influence of a type of coating and conditions of deposition on the shape and structure of topography of coatings and on their mechanical and operational properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fractal character of the surface is a good indicator of its topographical properties.
the fractal analysis can be a useful and effective method for characterising the surface topography of coatings.
the fractal character of topography of coatings deposited by CVD method on the tool materials is determined by a type of process, conditions of deposition, and the structure of a substrate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

it was proved that the fractal analysis of surface topography gives an opportunity to describe and characterise a shape of surface and its structure, which is an important element of a tool's life cycle.
a shape of surface of coatings obtained by CVD is a function of a type of pro cess as well as of a type of substrate material and its surface preparation.
a fractal dimension of surface is a parameter, which can be used to describe and to characterise the shape of surface topography.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to predict properties of coatings based on fractal quant ities describing their surface.
it is possible to predict the properties of coatings based on the fractal quantities describing the surface.
the surface fractal dimension of coatings is an important parameter for the prediction of their mechanical and tribological properties.
